Name: Nyapu-style's Lavril and Lucikiel Portraits
Author: zilchaz
Description:
Nyapu-style portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307]Lucikiel[/url]﻿.﻿ 

That's all!

As Nyapu had posted on their mod page that they won't draw some characters, so I chose characters I play with and personally drew them to match Nyapu's art style, by using their artwork as a reference under their permission.



[b]Note: [/b]In order to make them compatible with a curtain event, the file named [font=Courier New][u]EloisePJ.png[/u][/font] was taken from Nyapu's Portraits(ES) on the original mod.

.

The original art style belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] and their original mod:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong
[/url](And the CP version﻿﻿s of their original mod converted by me: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16383](CP) Nyapu's Portraits (SVE-RSV-ES and Custom NPCs)[/url])
